faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before subscribing.
faq.q1: Can I change my plan anytime?
faq.a1: Yes — you can upgrade or cancel your subscription anytime from your control panel. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.q2: Is there a minimum commitment period?
faq.a2: No. All plans are month-to-month with no contract. Annual billing saves you 20% compared to monthly. You can cancel anytime from your control panel.
faq.q3: Is the Free plan truly free?
faq.a3: Yes — no credit card required, no time limit. The Free plan allows you to explore PISUM with 10 templates, 50 reports per month, and PDF export. You can upgrade when you're ready.
faq.a4: AI Dictation converts your voice into structured radiology report text in real-time. It operates via a secure API — audio is never stored. Your monthly quota resets on the 1st of each month.
faq.a5: All payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, a PCI-compliant payment platform. PISUM never stores your banking information.
faq.q6: Where is my data stored? Is PISUM GDPR compliant?
faq.a6: Your patient reports are stored locally on your machine — PISUM never uploads clinical data to the cloud. Account data (name, email, subscription status) is hosted on Supabase with EU servers. PISUM is fully GDPR compliant.
faq.q7: Does PISUM require an internet connection?
faq.a7: Yes. PISUM requires an active internet connection for AI Dictation, AI Enhancer, and subscription management. While your patient reports and templates are stored locally on your machine, AI features securely connect to our cloud API.
faq.q8: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
faq.a8: The Free plan is a permanent free tier — no time limit, no credit card required. Starter, Pro, and Expert plans include a 14-day free trial so you can experience the full feature set risk-free before being charged. All paid plans are backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee.

index.why_p3: PISUM takes the opposite approach: patient data stays encrypted on your machine, reports follow structured radiology vocabulary, and the whole workflow is built for GDPR and HIPAA compliance from the start.

index.p_17: Expert-built for CT, MRI, X-Ray, and Ultrasound across every body system. Each field has clinical validation.
index.p_18: Professionally formatted output ready for PACS, EMR, or direct delivery. Your letterhead, your layout.
index.p_19: Compatible with all major voice recognition tools. Dictate directly into structured fields.

index.p_21: Share the patient database across all workstations in your clinic via a shared local network folder. One shared folder on your LAN is all it takes. AES-256 encrypted end-to-end.

index.p_23: Instantly translate any completed radiology report into another language. Clinical terminology preserved, report structure intact — one click, 23 target languages.

index.comp_h2:

medical practice.
index.comp_desc: PISUM is a report formatting and AI enhancement tool — not a diagnostic device. No CE marking required. Designed from the ground up for French and European regulatory requirements.
index.comp_c1_desc: Patient data is encrypted on your own machine. Nothing is uploaded to the cloud. Your data never leaves your practice network.
index.comp_c2_desc: Full data portability and right-to-erasure support. Every data access and export is logged in an immutable audit trail that satisfies CNIL documentation requirements.
index.comp_c3_desc: PACS-style traceability for every report — creation, modification, export, and deletion events, each stamped with timestamp and user identity.
index.comp_c4_desc: Designed to meet HDS hosting requirements. Certification roadmap underway — no false claim, honest timeline.
index.comp_disclaimer: Regulatory status: PISUM is a report formatting and dictation assistance tool, not a medical device. It does not produce diagnostic output — clinical decisions remain entirely yours. No CE marking or MDR classification applies under current scope.
index.lang_optimized: Optimized for medical and radiology terminology

index.ai_p: PISUM reads your findings, identifies the unified clinical syndrome, calibrates diagnostic certainty with academic precision, and flags life-threatening conditions first.
index.ai_cert_exclude: Cannot exclude Subtle or indirect sign only
index.ai_pillar1_desc: Elevates casual dictation or telegraphic notes to academic-grade radiology prose — indistinguishable from publications in Radiology or European Radiology. Both FORMAT and terminology are preserved.
index.ai_pillar2_desc: Cross-correlates all findings to name the unified syndrome — not a list of components, but the diagnosis itself. Budd-Chiari. Conn syndrome. Metastatic pattern. The conclusion you would have written anyway, in seconds.
index.ai_pillar3_desc: Vascular thrombosis, active bleeding, tension findings, organ ischemia — life-threatening findings always appear as the first conclusion bullet, clearly flagged with urgency level. Never buried in boilerplate.
index.ai_cta_sub: Pro+ plans · Works in all 23 languages
index.feat_ai_desc: Dictate or type findings in plain language. PISUM reformulates them to academic-grade radiology vocabulary, cross-correlates all signs to name the unified syndrome, calibrates diagnostic certainty, and flags life-threatening findings first — like a senior radiologist reviewing every report.
